Finds the record by its name, whatever the case and spacing, or makes it.

Every endpoint of this router works so: what several profiles share is
looked up first and added only when it is missing.
A faculty is the same one when its university and name are.
For a workplace: an organization, or a university, with that name.

A token that lets its bearer register an account for the person,

400.description: The person already has an account

get.description:
The caller's whole profile: name, birthdate, diet, student card, contacts.

`404 PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` until the user has made one.

post.description:
Makes the caller's profile in one transaction and links it to the account.

A user makes one profile for themselves: a second attempt is
`403 PROFILE_ALREADY_EXISTS`. The access token carries the linked person
only after its next refresh; profile endpoints do not depend on it.

409.description: The account claims a person that the profile service has no link for

put.description: Replaces the whole profile: a student card or a contact left out is removed.
